run_api: run the AutoTrain API server on a specified host and port using uvicorn
run_api_custom_port: run the AutoTrain API on a custom port and host address
register_subcommand: register the api subcommand with port, host, and task arguments to an ArgumentParser
run_api_command_factory: create a RunAutoTrainAPICommand instance from parsed CLI arguments
review_RunAutoTrainAPICommand: review the RunAutoTrainAPICommand class that initializes and runs the AutoTrain API via uvicorn
